_description: Pre-flight checks configuration with TOON optimization

checks.name: tests_passing
checks.description: GitHub Actions workflow status must be success
checks.remediation: Fix failing tests → push → wait for green CI

checks.name: version_bumped
checks.description: VERSION file changed in last commit
checks.remediation: Update VERSION file → commit if versioning needed

checks.name: image_sizes_reasonable
checks.remediation: Check multi-stage build configuration → optimize layers

checks.name: ci_pipeline_success
checks.description: All GitHub Actions jobs completed successfully
checks.command: gh run view --json jobs | jq '.jobs[] | select(.conclusion != "success")'
checks.remediation: Fix failing CI jobs → rerun workflow

checks.name: image_versions_updated
checks.description: IMAGE_VERSIONS.json hashes match current git state
checks.remediation: Check IMAGE_VERSIONS.json → may need CI rebuild

checks.name: health_checks_configured
checks.description: All 5 services have healthcheck in docker-compose.yml

checks.name: gh_cli_available
checks.description: GitHub CLI для мониторинга CI/CD (optional for --wait-for-build)
checks.remediation: Install GitHub CLI: https://cli.github.com (required only with --wait-for-build flag)

toon.checks_toon:
id|name|description|blocking|severity|remediation
1|tests_passing|GitHub Actions workflow status must be success|true|critical|Fix failing tests → push → wait for green CI
2|version_bumped|VERSION file changed in last commit|false|warning|Update VERSION file → commit if versioning needed
3|lockfile_updated|package-lock.json synchronized with package.json|false|warning|Run 'npm install' → commit package-lock.json
4|image_sizes_reasonable|Total Docker image size < 1.5 GB|false|warning|Check multi-stage build configuration → optimize layers
5|ci_pipeline_success|All GitHub Actions jobs completed successfully|true|critical|Fix failing CI jobs → rerun workflow
6|image_versions_updated|IMAGE_VERSIONS.json hashes match current git state|false|warning|Check IMAGE_VERSIONS.json → may need CI rebuild
7|health_checks_configured|All 5 services have healthcheck in docker-compose.yml|false|warning|Add healthcheck sections to docker-compose.yml
8|gh_cli_available|GitHub CLI для мониторинга CI/CD (optional for --wait-for-build)|false|info|Install GitHub CLI: https://cli.github.com (required only with --wait-for-build flag)
toon.note: TOON format for checks array. Blocking checks: 1, 5 (critical). Warning checks: 2, 3, 4, 6, 7. Info check: 8.
